answer: Sybil resistance uses bonded stake tiers where each identity must post collateral scaling with its trust rank, so an attacker's cost curve reaches a summit only by locking capital across many verified accounts. Colluders who push reputation to its nadir trigger a quarantine that isolates their cluster as walled garden, preventing contagion to honest peers. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
